ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.3.1 Playtest adds explicit AdaptiveTPS coexistence for its TickManagerUpdate transpiler while keeping unknown Harmony conflicts fail-closed. It also strengthens PathFinder diagnostics: RimMT observes both FindPath overloads at high Harmony priority, reports detailed eligibility rejection reasons, distinguishes startup from runtime reports, tracks dispatcher activity, and cleans up failed worker requests safely. Worker-side path A* remains validation-only and vanilla PawnPath remains authoritative.
